summary: Delta Hardware is a 2006 studio album by blues harp player and vocalist Charlie Musselwhite, described as his twenty-fourth studio album. It was released on Real World Records and is his second release with that label, following Sanctuary in 2004. The note also states that Musselwhite plays electric guitar on the track "Town to Town".
one_line: Delta Hardware is a 2006 blues album by harmonica player Charlie Musselwhite, released on Real World Records.
